programs.title: How Disney Built America
programs.desc: A cartoon studio creates one of the most recognisable characters in the world. Mickey Mouse begins as a pencil sketch, and through a journey of failure, innovation, and guts becomes an American icon.

programs.title: World War II With Tom Hanks
programs.desc: Japan escalates its war in China, drawing increasing US sanctions. Driven by resource shortages and military ideology, Japan attacks Pearl Harbor in a move that will reshape the course of World War II.

programs.title: The Bermuda Triangle: Into Cursed Waters
programs.desc: The team seeks out the wreck of the Revonoc, a racing yacht that vanished in 1958 with a crew of five. A freak magnetic anomaly was detected in the Triangle when she went missing.

programs.title: Hazardous History With Henry Winkler
programs.desc: Ever taken medical advice from a cigarette commercial? There was a time when any and all 'cures' could be sold to the public indiscriminately.

programs.title: World War II With Tom Hanks
programs.desc: Operation Barbarossa, Nazi Germany's surprise invasion of the Soviet Union, launches on June 22, 1941. In what is the largest military operation in history, Hitler aims to capture their economic resources.

programs.title: Hidden Cities
programs.desc: Explore an artificial cave carved out of molten lava, an East Java religious complex and a Dutch castle hidden beneath Semarang.

programs.title: The Death Coast
programs.desc: A powerful hurricane forces Jeff's team into a secluded cove, where they investigate The Lombrac, a legendary 18th-century ghost ship. The divers recover intriguing clues from the murky depths.

programs.title: Swamp People
programs.desc: As gator season approaches the halfway point, Troy and Pickle hunt a haunted honeyhole with a checkered past. Bruce searches for the monster threatening a local swimming hole.

programs.title: The Unbelievable With Dan Aykroyd
programs.desc: Shipwrecks, crashes, and UFO sightings, oh my! This episode explores the Lake Michigan Triangle and other places, including a doll-filled island with a dark past, and the most haunted place in the U.S.

programs.title: The Curse Of Oak Island
programs.desc: As the team moves closer to retrieving what they believe to be the Chappell Vault, a dangerous event occurs in the Money Pit and the Fellowship must adjust their plans quickly to avoid disaster.

programs.title: Secrets Declassified With David Duchovny
programs.desc: From the CIA's decades-long pursuit of the perfect truth serum to the U.S. Army's secret PsyOps in Vietnam, mind games have long been at play among countries, its enemies, and even its own citizens.

programs.title: Mountain Men
programs.desc: Lauro travels north of the Arctic Circle with his team of sled dogs to hunt caribou; Daniel rebuilds an old floating cabin using driftwood logs and the power of tides.
